 Print Latest weather update and forecast for Washington DC. Washington DC, October 26, 2026 – Today, Washington DC is set to experience a pleasant day characterized by abundant sunshine and mild temperatures. The high will reach 22°C while the low hovers around 8°C, making it an excellent opportunity for outdoor activities. Notably, there is no chance of rain expected, creating ideal conditions for residents to engage in various daytime pursuits. Washington DC Weather Today
 Today's weather is marked by bright and sunny spells throughout the day. Residents can expect a high of 22°C and a low of 8°C, with an average temperature settling at 15°C. Humidity levels will be relatively high at 93%, but without the threat of rainfall, the atmosphere will feel pleasantly dry and comfortable. Winds are expected to reach up to 19.31 kph, which may provide a refreshing breeze in the open. The clear and sunny skies should remain steady for most of the day, promoting great visibility. As the sun rises at 7:29 AM and sets around 6:15 PM, this long daylight duration will further enhance outdoor plans without any interruptions from rain. Good Conditions for Evening Activities
 With no forecasted rain and moderate temperatures, today is an excellent day to enjoy outdoor activities, whether it’s a stroll in the park, a picnic, or some delightful evening festivities. Residents are encouraged to take advantage of the sunshine, particularly in the warmer afternoon hours. The comfortable temperatures should be ideal for those planning to be outdoors into the evening as well. As the sun begins to set, temperatures will gradually cool down, allowing for a pleasant transition into the evening. It’s advisable to dress in layers if you plan to stay out later when the temperature decreases. Washington DC Weather for Upcoming 7 Days

 2026-10-30 25 12 Partly sunny and warm 
 2026-10-31 21 11 Partly sunny and nice 
 2026-11-01 20 13 Cloudy with a little rain in the afternoon 
 2026-11-02 20 12 Mostly cloudy 
 Following today’s clear skies, the next week promises a mix of pleasant and slightly cloudy days. Tomorrow, we’ll see similar warm conditions with a high of 22°C and a low of 8°C. The following days will have varying temperatures, with the warmest day reaching 25°C on October 30, which may encourage similar outdoor engagement. By November 1, the forecast indicates a shift as cloudy conditions and a slight chance of rain may persist, marking a transition into potentially wetter weather. Overall, early November is shaping up to be mild; however, residents should prepare for cloudy days after the sunny start to the week. Residents should continue to enjoy the great weather while it lasts, but also keep an eye on the changing conditions as the week progresses.
